aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable comparable evidence but the changed-factor and measurement grouping are not reliable enough for final use.
issues: Changed factor is overbroad and includes artifact value '1'.
VP+CD GAP and Dome deform are mixed as changed conditions instead of likely subgroup/defect contexts.
Several measurement outcomes are header-derived artifacts, not valid measurements.
Tension comparison is incomplete and misparsed from limited rows.
Evidence set is overbroad and includes uncited context not shown in draft rows.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to VP normal/Normal versus VP TEST Die punch V0 using die punch cutting inside V0.
Keep VP+CD GAP and Dome deform as subgroup or defect context unless proven primary conditions.
Remove bogus measurement/header-stat outcomes and rebuild only real metrics.
Rebuild tension outcome using paired VP TEST and VP normal rows by date and line.
Retain vision, air leak, and function outcomes under one validation report with precise row citations.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations mostly exist, but grouping citations are overbroad and some needed header/detail rows are missing.
